description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired). Detects parity gaps between SIBLING functions: two functions in a contract reach the same state transition but one omits a security-relevant component (validation / recipient-resolution / cap / access modifier / registry step / accounting write / pause guard) the sibling enforces. Anchored on Blackhole M-04 (RewardsDistributor.claim resolves avm.getOriginalOwner; claim_many omits it) and Size M-02/M-06. High precision over recall: two-signal gate (sibling kinship AND controlled-vocabulary asymmetry) + wrapper/admin/view/event-only suppression. NEVER mints or routes.

fp_controls.two_signal_required: sibling kinship (name-stem OR >=2 shared calls & jaccard>=0.3) AND a controlled-vocabulary asymmetry on a shared mutating path
fp_controls.controlled_component_filter: the missing token must map to a components[] vocabulary entry and must NOT be in exclude_components (events / interface casts / pure getters dominate corpus noise)
fp_controls.wrapper_suppression: if one sibling body is a single call to the other (forwarder/overload), suppress
fp_controls.both_admin_suppression: if both siblings carry an admin modifier, asymmetry is intended maintenance unless the weaker sibling is externally reachable by non-admins
fp_controls.no_observability_only: a missing emit with no correlated state/guard asymmetry is never emitted
fp_controls.one_level_helper_resolution: append same-contract helper bodies the sibling calls before declaring a component missing (validation may live in a shared _validate())
